title: Amps Assist
description: An automated, Dockerized media synchronization engine that bridges YouTube Music with Jellyfin and Plex media servers. Scrapes personalized mixes and library playlists, extracts high-fidelity audio with embedded ID3 metadata and cover art, builds server-compliant .m3u playlists, and triggers background server library refreshes across network storage.
Highlights: Automated YouTube Music synchronization pipeline parsing personalized algorithmic mixes ('Mixed for you', 'From the community') and custom library playlists via authenticated browser session emulation
Lossless and high-bitrate audio extraction engine powered by yt-dlp and FFmpeg with automated mutagen ID3 tagging, embedded album art, and artist/album directory hierarchy creation
Direct REST API orchestration with Jellyfin and Plex to trigger instantaneous background library refreshes, regenerate .m3u playlists, and sync live media without manual server rescans
Intelligent storage lifecycle manager detecting user-preserved playlists ('save' marker) while automatically purging orphaned .mp3 audio files and ghost directories
Containerized deployment built on Python 3.12, Docker, and Docker Compose with CIFS/SMB network volume mounting and scheduled background synchronization cycles
